title: Selected industry/governance positions

records.documented_position: Published a Frontier Governance Framework covering areas including cyber offense, CBRN risks, harmful manipulation, loss of control, incident response and external expert input.
Responsible Scaling Policy v3 describes a voluntary framework intended to mitigate catastrophic risks and increase transparency/accountability.
Reuters reported Zuckerberg opposing a coordinated development slowdown while arguing labs have incentives and responsibility to build safely.
Reuters reported a September 2026 industry debate over slowing frontier development, with disagreement among major companies and executives.

editorial_rule: Present positions side-by-side without ranking them or attributing unstated motives.
